chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 393: The Asura King's Banner Taken by Keke
chapter_meta_description: Keke steals the White Bone Sovereign Banner from the Asura King, igniting a chaotic battle among foreign kings. Xiao Chen harvests fallen kings' life essence and retreats to cultivate at the blood pool.
og_title: WoI 393: White Bone Banner Stolen, Xiao Chen Cultivates
og_description: In the chaos following Keke's theft of the ancient banner, Xiao Chen secretly harvests the lives of fallen kings to fuel his own resurrection. The blood pool awaits.
twitter_title: World of Immortality 393: The Banner and the Blood Pool
twitter_description: Keke's bold theft of the White Bone Sovereign Banner triggers a kingly free-for-all. Xiao Chen harvests fallen kings and retreats to the blood pool for cultivation.
